providers.evidence_boundary: Base documents mainnet.base.org as its standard Base mainnet RPC and identifies Coinbase Technologies, Inc. as the counterparty for the Coinbase-operated Base services. This is a candidate control classification pending independent data-owner and security/privacy review.

Tenderly documents base.gateway.tenderly.co as its Base mainnet production node and describes its gateway as a Tenderly-operated node service with archival reads. This is a candidate control classification pending independent data-owner and security/privacy review.

approval.boundary: The author of this candidate cannot self-approve organizational independence. Approval requires two distinct named reviewers, one for data ownership and one for security/privacy, bound to the exact registry body hash.

evidence_boundary: Different HTTPS authorities alone do not prove different controlling organizations. The proposed control-principal mapping is evidence-backed but remains unapproved; captures made against it cannot authorize QICSWU publication or deployment.
